strings.account.logout.message: After signing out, this Mac goes offline for this account and can no longer be controlled by it.
strings.login.title: Sign in
strings.login.server.info: Copy the full address from the Server Info page of the admin console. The format is host:port#sha256-fingerprint. The client pins this fingerprint and refuses to connect if the server certificate changes, which prevents man-in-the-middle attacks.
strings.login.totp.title: Two-step verification
strings.login.totp.prompt: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
strings.login.change.title: Set a new password
strings.login.change.prompt: Set your own password before the first sign-in completes.
strings.login.change.info: Your new password is only used locally in the OPAQUE exchange; neither the server nor administrators can learn it. If you forget it, an administrator must reset it and you will need to sign in again on every device.
strings.login.revoked: This device was signed out. Please sign in again
strings.hosts.tags.info: Separate tags with commas. Use the chips above the list to filter by tag.
strings.hosts.delete.title: Delete item
strings.hosts.delete.message: Delete "{0}"? It will be removed on all devices of this account.
strings.hosts.delete.folderMessage: Delete folder "{0}"? Items inside are moved up one level, not deleted.
strings.device.lanOnly: Offline on the server, reachable on the local network
strings.device.selfHint: This is the computer you are using.
strings.device.mobileHint: Mobile devices can control others but cannot be controlled.
strings.device.remove.title: Remove device
strings.device.remove.message: Removing "{0}" signs it out of this account. It will reappear only after signing in on that device again.
strings.cred.privateKey.info: Paste an OpenSSH, PEM or PKCS#8 private key, or import it from a file. Keys and passphrases are end-to-end encrypted before being stored on the server, which never sees them in plain text.
strings.known.delete.title: Delete known host
strings.known.delete.message: The host fingerprint of {0} will be confirmed again on the next connection.
strings.editor.label: Name
strings.ssh.auth.info: Password: saved, or asked on every connection. Private key: uses a key from the keychain. Keyboard-interactive: answer the server's prompts (for example a one-time code). SSH agent: uses keys loaded in the local ssh-agent.
strings.ssh.password.ask: Leave empty to ask every time
strings.ssh.password.info: Saved passwords are end-to-end encrypted and synced to all devices of this account.
strings.ssh.jumpVia.info: If the host lives in the private network of one of your devices and is not reachable directly, pick that device and the connection is forwarded through it. You can also pick another SSH host as a jump host (up to 3 hops).
strings.hostkey.new.title: First connection to this host
strings.hostkey.new.message: No host key has been recorded for {0} yet. Check that the fingerprint below matches the server. Once trusted it is saved to the vault and checked on every later connection.
strings.hostkey.changed.title: Host key has changed
strings.hostkey.changed.message: The host key of {0} does not match the one recorded in the vault. The server may have been reinstalled or rekeyed, or someone may be impersonating it.
strings.hostkey.changed.hint: Do not continue unless you know this change is expected.
strings.rdp.jump.info: With a via device, a port forward is set up through it first and the remote desktop app connects to the local port.
strings.rdp.info: Opens in Microsoft Windows App (rdp:// link). With a via device, a port on this Mac is forwarded through that device to the target's RDP port. The password is not put in the link; enter it in Windows App.
strings.rdp.noclient.title: No remote desktop app found
strings.rdp.noclient.body: RDP hosts open in Microsoft Windows App (formerly Microsoft Remote Desktop). Install it for free from the App Store, then connect again.
strings.rdp.badAddress: The RDP host address is invalid. Check it and connect again.
strings.rdp.forwarding: {0} is forwarded through the device to local port {1}. Stop the forward at the bottom when you are done.
strings.rdp.bar.title: RDP forwards
strings.rdp.bar.info: An RDP host with a via device gets a port on this Mac that is forwarded through that device to the target; the remote desktop app connects to that port. Click Stop when you are done. All forwards are closed when you sign out or quit.
strings.terminal.killed: Session ended on the remote device
strings.terminal.sessions.title: Sessions kept on the remote device
strings.sftp.home.title: Choose a device or host to browse files
strings.sftp.name: Name
strings.sftp.chmod.title: Permissions: {0}
strings.sftp.delete.title: Delete
strings.sftp.delete.irreversible: Deleting on the remote side cannot be undone.
strings.sftp.remoteDirUnsupported: Copying whole folders between two remote sides is not supported yet
strings.remote.noDisplay: No display available on the remote device
strings.ai.new.info: The agent loop runs on this Mac and operates targets over end-to-end encrypted sessions. The server only relays model requests and records usage; it never stores conversations. The effective permission is the strictest of the mode chosen here, your administrator's limit and the limit set by the owner of each target.
strings.ai.disabled: AI is not enabled for your account
strings.ai.model.info: Enabled by your administrator on the server. Models marked Vision can read screenshots and operate Windows / macOS desktops; other models can only use the accessibility tree.
strings.ai.noVisionHint: The selected model cannot read images, so desktops can only be operated through the accessibility tree. Pick a vision model for complex interfaces.
strings.ai.targets.info: Pick one or more devices or SSH hosts. Linux and SSH hosts run commands like a terminal; on Windows / macOS the model reads the screen, clicks and types.
strings.ai.mode.info: Read-only: only read operations are allowed. Confirm every step: every state-changing action needs your approval. Confirm dangerous (default): normal actions run automatically; dangerous or unrecognized ones need approval. Full trust: everything runs automatically except the forbidden list, optionally for a limited time.
strings.ai.planFirst.info: The model must first propose a plan; nothing runs until you agree.
strings.ai.task.placeholder: Describe what you want the agent to do
strings.ai.secret.title: Password required
strings.ai.secret.info: What you type is sent by the core directly to the target (into the terminal or input field). It is never sent to the model and never stored in the conversation.
strings.assist.connect.title: Connect with assistance code
strings.assist.connect.info: On an unsigned LemonGalaxy, the other person sees a 9-digit device code and a verification code. The verification code is shown only on their screen and never passes through the server; the session starts only after they click Allow.
strings.assist.request.title: Someone wants to control this Mac
strings.assist.request.info: If you allow, they can see the screen and use the mouse and keyboard. Local security settings are locked during assistance; you can disconnect at any time from the menu bar icon or the banner at the top right.
strings.local.overview.info: This Mac is both a controller and a host. Host settings can only be changed on this Mac; nobody remote, including the server, can change them.
strings.local.perm.missing: Screen Recording or Accessibility is not granted yet, so others cannot see or control the screen.
strings.local.noSessions: Nobody is connected to this Mac
strings.local.accounts.info: Permissions are set per signed-in account. Terminals, files and commands run as the system user configured here, enforced by macOS.
strings.local.controlOnlyOne.info: The controller app can be signed in to one account at a time, used for both controlling and being controlled. Install the host-only client if several accounts need to control this Mac.
strings.local.perm.aiCap.info: The highest mode an AI agent of this account can use on this Mac, regardless of what the controller selects.
strings.local.systemUser.info: The macOS user that terminals, file operations and commands of this account run as.
strings.local.assist.info: Get help without signing in: tell the helper the device code and verification code, they enter them in their LemonGalaxy, and the session starts once you allow it. The verification code is generated locally and the server never sees it.
strings.local.assist.custom.info: 8 to 16 characters. Cannot be changed while assistance is in progress.
strings.local.events.info: Every connection, file operation and command is logged on this Mac; actions started by AI are marked separately.
strings.local.perm.info: Being controlled needs two macOS permissions that only you can grant in System Settings. This page updates automatically once granted.
strings.local.perm.screen.info: Lets others see this Mac's screen; also used for AI screenshots.
strings.local.perm.accessibility.info: Lets others use the mouse and keyboard; also used by AI to read the UI tree.
strings.snippet.info: Snippets are end-to-end encrypted and synced to all devices. Use the snippet button in a terminal's header to insert them.
strings.account.changePassword.info: Changing your password does not sign out other devices; account keys stay the same.
strings.account.totp.info: When on, signing in also needs the 6-digit code from an authenticator app. Your administrator may require it.
strings.account.totp.scan: Scan the QR code with an authenticator app or enter the key manually, then type the 6-digit code it shows.
strings.account.totp.unsupported: The current core does not provide self-service two-step verification yet
strings.settings.language.info: The interface language changes immediately. New languages only need a file in the app's Locales resource folder.
strings.settings.terminal.theme.info: Themes are JSON files in the app's TerminalThemes resource folder; add a file to add a theme. Individual SSH hosts can override the theme in their editor.
strings.settings.terminal.optionMeta.info: When on, Option combinations send an Esc prefix (needed by emacs and bash shortcuts). When off, Option types special characters.
strings.settings.connection.display.info: Actual quality also adapts to the network. Frame rates the host hardware cannot reach fall back to the highest available.
strings.settings.connection.h265.info: Lower bitrate at the same quality. Falls back to H.264 when the host hardware lacks support.
strings.settings.connection.reattach.info: Terminal sessions stay alive on the host after a disconnect. When some are kept, you are asked whether to re-attach or start a new one.
strings.about.mock.info: This session uses the built-in mock core (fake devices, files and AI) for demos and self-tests; it is used when launched with --mock or LEMONGALAXY_MOCK=1. A normal launch uses the Rust core.
strings.settings.autoHideList: Collapse the list while a session tab is open
strings.settings.autoHideList.info: Terminal, file, desktop and AI tabs get more room; the list comes back when you return to the home tab.
strings.local.account.active: Signed in; used for this Mac
strings.local.account.needsRelogin: Reset by the administrator; sign in again
strings.local.perm.notify.info: Show a banner with a disconnect button at the top right while someone is connected or AI is operating.
strings.remote.closed: The remote side stopped sharing the screen
strings.remote.privacy.on: Privacy screen on: the remote screen is blank and its local keyboard and mouse are disabled
strings.remote.privacy.failed: Could not switch the privacy screen: {0}
strings.remote.privacy.help: Blanks the remote screen and disables its local keyboard and mouse while you keep working. Turns off automatically when you disconnect.
strings.remote.privacy.noControl: You need control permission to use the privacy screen
strings.update.section.info: Asks your server for a newer version. The server only relays release packages; updates with an invalid signature or missing from the signed list are rejected, and the SHA-256 is checked after download. Checked automatically once a day after you sign in.
strings.update.title: New version available
strings.update.noNotes: No release notes for this version
strings.update.verified: Release signature verified. The SHA-256 is checked after download.
strings.update.downloaded: {0} was downloaded to your Downloads folder and opened. Drag LemonGalaxy into the Applications folder to replace the old version, then open LemonGalaxy again.
